verdict.rationale: LiteLLM is built around a documented programmatic interface. Its docs cover a single completion() interface across providers and OpenAI-format responses. They also document a drop-in OpenAI-compatible proxy, REST endpoints for MCP tools callable with curl, and JSON payloads for team and budget management, and a maintainer confirmed the proxy supports streaming and function-calling like the openai-python SDK. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found (all probed paths returned 404), admin endpoints for keys, teams and users are only thinly evidenced through config/JSON snippets, and there is no independent hands-on verification of the API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Call any provider using the same completion() interface, with no API to re-learn for each one
